subject: The newsletter layer beside company data
body:
Your docs describe Crustdata as a place to "query indexed datasets of companies, people, jobs, and social posts", with activity read from executive moves, news and product launches. Newsletter publications sit just outside that set, and they carry a kind of activity the other four do not: what a company is being discussed for, in whose newsletter, on what date.

We read a corpus of newsletters, with topic and sponsor extraction and the source URL on every observation. It could arrive as a sixth dataset in your schema, or as an enrichment field on company records.

If useful, I will pull 500 companies you already cover and send the newsletter mentions, topics and sponsors we hold, with timestamps, so you can compare against your current activity signals.
